title: Cooperative localization on real UWB: MILUV drones through the swarm-coop filters
summary: Runs the unmodified filters of swarm-coop-localization (dead reckoning, centralized EKF, naive decentralized, covariance intersection; plain vs robust ranging; gate / vote / solution-separation integrity) on real two-way UWB ranges from the MILUV dataset (3 quadcopters, 6 anchors, mocap truth). A stdlib HTTP-range reader pulls only the mocap, uwb_range and height CSVs out of 3-11 GB experiment zips. Two drones get 2-D fixes from multilateration of their own real anchor ranges, the third is denied and uses only real inter-drone ranges (horizontal projection with the height rangefinder) and synthetic odometry. Reports real range error vs the sim's UWB model, per-drone RMSE with real ranges and with the sim's error model on the same geometry, and detection time for a ramp bias on one drone's anchor ranges or on the denied drone's inter-drone ranges, with no-fault controls. Finding: the error core matches the sim (robust sd ~0.10 m) but the real tail stops at 1.9 m where the sim puts 9 % of ranges beyond 5 m, so robust ranging stops mattering; cooperative gain, CI consistency, faulty-anchor propagation and centralized solution separation all reproduce.
verified: Ran 2026-11-06 with /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 3.14.7, stdlib only. fetch_miluv.py fetched the CSVs of default_3_zigzag_0, default_3_random_0 and cirObstacles_3_random_0 by HTTP range (31.4 + 12.6 + 10.6 MB over the wire from 11.1 / 3.2 / 3.2 GB zips). run_real.py stats / nominal / fault / fault --kind peer outputs saved in out/ and quoted in the README (30 runs per table: 3 denied-drone choices x 10 odometry seeds). Truth re-derived from mocap matches the devkit gt_range within 1 cm on 99.91 % of rows. 15 unittest tests pass with data, 7 pass + 8 skip without data; a mutation zeroing the injected fault makes the SS detection test fail. Not verified: real odometry (it is synthetic from mocap), lever-arm or 3-D models, comms, UTIL TDoA data, the MILUV devkit itself (not installed or run).
first_command: python3 fetch_miluv.py && python3 run_real.py stats && python3 run_real.py fault
shows: Swarm-coop filters on real MILUV inter-drone UWB: real vs simulated range error, DR vs centralized vs CI, injected anchor fault and detection time
runtime: first-command download 31.4 MB in ~1 min (all three experiments 54.6 MB); stats < 2 s; nominal ~2 min; each fault run ~3 min; tests ~4 s
key_result: [Sim vs real](README.md#how-the-sims-conclusions-hold-on-real-data): real UWB core sd ~0.10 m like the sim but max 1.9 m vs the sim's 9 % > 5 m, so plain = robust on real ranges; denied drone 0.48 m DR => 0.20 m centralized, 0.27 m CI; centralized SS detects a biased-anchor fault 30/30 at median 42 s, 0 false alarms in 30 clean runs
